# Replays the option-exercise server-rejection lifecycle (OPT-002) observed
# on 2026-06-11 against live paper Gateway: a MKT BUY 1 of the deep-ITM AAPL
# Jun-12 282.5 call fills at 8.90, then exerciseOptions is accepted as a
# working instruction. The Gateway answers on the exercise request id with
# code 10349 "Order TIF was set to DAY based on order preset." and then
# materializes the instruction as an order whose order id IS the exercise
# request id (live id 5, perm id sanitized to 900005 after that live id):
# open_order/order_status PreSubmitted for an LMT BUY 1 with no order ref.
# Twenty seconds later, when the driver's teardown global cancel ran, the
# paper Gateway killed the working instruction: code 322 "Error processing
# request.Exercise/Lapse failed due to server rejection.", order_status
# Cancelled, and the code-202 cancellation notice, all on the exercise id.
# Engine surfacing frozen here: the exercise request route turns 10349 and
# 322 into session events; 322 retires that route, so the following 202 uses
# the unmatched-request session fallback. The pseudo-order open_order and
# order_status frames still match no order route and drop. The 161 answering
# the global cancel for order 407 is also a session notice, preserving its
# clean Filled handle result.
# Sanitized: account identifiers redacted to DU9000001, perm ids -> 900407
# and 900005, order ref -> ibkrgo-sanitized-20260611T133636Z-001, execution
# id -> sanitized-exercise-fill-001. Trimmed: farm-status 2104/2107/2158,
# the driver's startup safety global cancel and its code-161 replies, the
# delayed-quote anchor exchange, the sec-def option parameter and
# contract-details qualification exchange, the executions snapshot, and the
# teardown global cancel's code-161 replies for previous scenarios' orders.
